notes: Every game is built as a .d64 disk too, in Lite and Pro. Level screens can give each level its own lines, for a mission briefing, and the bitmap strip can be up to 12 rows (Pro). Losing a life can make the player catch fire and jump off the screen. Shooters get a play area: gaps from each edge, and edges that stop the ship, take a life or wrap round; Solid tiles can stop the ship and you can draw your own explosion. Patrol and Crawler enemies can turn round on a timer, spawners can choose whether their enemies count towards the goal, and hidden exits act as empty tiles until they open.
